payload.tension: The passage states colossians 2:18–22 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it is locally described; the wording centers on “If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
